overview_description.description: Quivr is a platform for decentralized social ID and verification. It verifies consumers' online footprints via apps linked to various social platforms (e.g., Twitter, Spotify, LinkedIn, and so on) and issues verification badges that are minted into their personal NFTs and recorded on the blockchain.
